# Coverage — ISO/IEC 27001:2022 clauses 4-10 — where each requirement is met

**Source.** ISO/IEC 27001:2022, clauses 4 to 10

The Annex A controls are only half of the standard; the management-system clauses are met by procedures, registers and generated artefacts. This mapping is the auditor's index for the Stage 1 documentation review.

## Summary

| Requirements | Covered | Partial | Gap |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 25 | 25 | 0 | 0 |

*Covered* = every mapped control is applicable and implemented and every mapped document is approved; *partial* = at least one mapped control is partially implemented or planned, or a mapped document is still a draft or in review; *gap* = a mapped control is not applicable or not implemented, or a document is missing or retired.
